CHAPTER 01
General overview

Description: The internet penetration rate in India rose over 70 percent in 2025, from about 15 percent in 2015. Although these figures seem relatively low, it meant that more than half of the population of 1.47 billion people had internet access that year. This also
ranked the country second in the world in terms of active internet users. Read more
Note(s): India; October 2015 to October 2025
Source(s): DataReportal; Eurostat; Google; GSMA ; ITU; Kepios; Meltwater; United Nations; We Are Social

these were also active social media users. The traffic in the world’s second-largest internet market at this stage was largely dominated by mobile internet users. Read more
Note(s): India; February 2025
